message.content:
I understand that schemas can be a bit overwhelming, especially if you're not familiar with them. But don't worry! You don't have to give up on tracking your expenses. I'm here to help simplify things for you.

Using Excel is certainly an option, but a well-designed schema can provide you with structured data that is easy to analyze and report on. If you’re feeling confused, we can take it one step at a time.

How about we focus on one specific aspect of your expense tracking needs? For example, do you want to start with just categorization and build from there? Or perhaps you're interested in tracking specific types of expenses? Let’s work together to create a solution that feels manageable for you!
